name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.17.20 distinguishes host consent refusal, cancellation, unavailable capability, timeout and errors; only classified transient failures permit one extra consent attempt on the same snapshot. Short category queries retain full final requirement checks. Explicit feature withdrawal preserves unrelated constraints; ambiguous goal changes clarify first. Research cards fold by default, with missing evidence visible. Qualified products from unverified merchants may request one bounded authorized web recovery; unknown merchants never gain automatic trust. Snapshot references, URL/price binding and read-only limits remain intact. Automated tests do not establish actual Codex consent or Chrome end-to-end acceptance. v0.17.19 separates qualified fits from research cards and enables one host-authorized, snapshot-bound text web-recovery session. Compact functional queries preserve all hard requirements. Server-owned page verification produces up to three native cards and comparisons; consent, expiry, five-page bounds, URL/variant/price binding, merchant trust and old selection references remain enforced. Non-color requirements no longer become color selectors. Hosts without MCP form elicitation fail closed; actual Codex Chrome end-to-end acceptance remains separate from automated tests. v0.17.18 fixes text-search variant prices from Product JSON-LD offers, preserves explicit color/size and complete product names in official retrieval, and keeps unpriced or unverified research leads from ending search replenishment early. Text responses no longer repeat obsolete source clarification questions. Identity, trust, budgets, immutable selections and image-review safety remain unchanged. Live US 7 price parsing recovered; unresolved brand/color coverage is not claimed as fixed. v0.17.17 preserves explicit requirements across snapshot-bound follow-ups, validates category-specific sizes and hair features, separates unknown evidence from satisfied products, and inspects bounded exact-product variants before recommendations. Awin negotiates backward-compatible requirement filtering before top-N without a second resident index. Cards and comparisons share requirement and variant evidence; verified merchant trust cannot come from product ratings. Unicode evidence is fenced and capped before strict output validation. Immutable selections, source identity, prices, budgets and read-only boundaries remain enforced. US 7 live recall and held-out visual accuracy are not claimed. v0.17.16 removes the persistent local official-product catalog and its importer; products use real-time official, Awin, Shopify and configured eBay sources. Reviewed storefront/trusted-merchant registries, same-search memory reuse and Watch storage remain. Official searches continue after failed image review without repeating already attempted queries; second-round slots preserve prior candidates and reserve fresh retrieval. Swimwear, bodysuits and jumpsuits cannot silently enter dress/top results. HTTP request/body accounting, variant proof and all identity, merchant-trust, image-review, price and read-only safety limits remain enforced. Six known development images retain 5/6 target recall; Nataly and held-out accuracy acceptance remain unresolved. Historical release notes: v0.17.15 fixes whole-token color evidence, preserves fine floral and structural cues, skips duplicate locale sitemaps, expands bounded JSON-LD discovery and follows at most one safe next-page link. A six-image development replay recovered 5/6 target colorways; Nataly keyword recall and held-out accuracy acceptance remain unresolved. Prices, stock, identity, merchant trust, image review and read-only boundaries remain unchanged. v0.17.14 improves generic official-store visual retrieval with compact visible-structure queries, bounded ranked ItemList parsing, and source-proven alphabetic size SKUs. A paired development replay recovered Zeno and Oren (0/2 to 2/2); global visual acceptance and Julia's original colorway remain outstanding. Security and identity gates are unchanged. v0.17.13 adds bounded visual funnel diagnostics, pattern/palette retention, raw-image deduplication, a reviewed official catalog adapter, merchant-qualified snapshot references, and variant-aware stock/size messages. Identity, merchant trust, prices and read-only safety remain fail closed. Six-image development target recall is 0/6 without brand and 1/6 with brand; formal visual accuracy acceptance remains outstanding. v0.17.12 prioritizes structural visual matches before review truncation, reviews remaining original candidates before supplemental retrieval, preserves reliable color and length anchors, and avoids duplicate failed image reads. The two-review-round limit, shared request and payload budgets, immutable candidate IDs, and fail-closed identity and merchant safety gates remain unchanged. v0.17.11 improves bounded visual retrieval with unified observation/visibility evidence, 240-character observation values, one structure-preserving relaxed pass, failed-image backfill, variant-aware deduplication, and cards built from accepted candidates across passes. Catalog, image and coupon reads share per-search budgets and safe correlated diagnostics. Invalid inputs return safe correction details without weakening execution safety. Candidate ranking, primary choices and comparisons share deterministic assessment; comparisons expose conditions and limitations. Coupon lookup failures differ from no offers, and explicit product-scope or eligibility restrictions cannot be overridden by a product ID or used to invent a lower ranking price. Preferred eligible offers are summarized and other offers are folded. v0.17.10 keeps prior-card follow-ups bound to the immutable search snapshot: selected-product and comparison schemas require renderId, direct UI comparisons bind IDs to that snapshot, missing context fails at the shared execution boundary, and only truly unavailable snapshots are described as expired. v0.17.9 makes card choices usable from natural-language follow-ups: UI selection changes sync to execution-owned immutable render snapshots with monotonic revisions, comparisons may resolve those same-snapshot choices by renderId, and numbered references resolve by one-based position without title guessing. Missing, stale, foreign, and cross-snapshot references fail closed. v0.17.8 makes Awin category discovery fail closed before trust, Coupon, or price ranking: whole-token matching prevents wig from matching wiggle, English singular/plural variants remain searchable, and unrequested wig tape, bands, caps, glue, and related accessories are excluded while explicit accessory searches remain supported. v0.17.7 shows current Coupon evidence directly on product cards and comparisons with explicit product-confirmed, merchant-wide, or unconfirmed applicability. Only a product-confirmed offer bound to the card's stable merchant product ID, with one unambiguous discount and no unresolved eligibility, may produce an estimated after-Coupon item price or affect equal-fit price ordering; merchant-wide Awin offers remain visible but never outrank a lower-priced product. The backend-selected primary recommendation is rendered first, while delivered-total comparisons keep quoted totals authoritative. v0.17.6 prevents a full product title from suppressing verified merchant-wide Awin offers, localizes no-offer and unavailable states, blocks empty comparison-ID calls, and rejects footwear terms such as slides, pumps, loafers, and mules before blouse or top image review. Comparison state stays inside the UI: cards provide sticky 2-4 selection, and the comparison view can quote delivered totals for those same immutable selection IDs with an in-view ZIP action. Visual search starts with brand and product family, performs one family-locked retry even when the first pass returns zero catalog candidates, preserves the top two structural details in that retry, and distinguishes zero retrieval candidates from secure image-load failure. Model-authored visual hard clues are downgraded at the execution boundary, and every candidate-image response stays nonterminal until its required visual finalization completes. Intended use stays outside product identity, requiredSize remains distinct from preferredSize, and real candidate-image payloads are bounded before they reach the shared safety executor. Every MCP tool routes through one shared safety executor, existing source ports remain behind a capability-based Backend facade, and the server generates the 2-4 column product comparison view. Comparison accepts only stable selections from one immutable live snapshot; the server determines same-product identity, facts, unknowns, limitations, common price basis, price delta, and the deterministic recommendation. Model-authored product facts and recommendation IDs are not accepted. Evidence-first search, three-tier card display, stable selected-product identity, and read-only safety boundaries remain unchanged. High-confidence suspected product names from interactive image analysis receive an exact official-store retrieval pass before descriptive visual fallback, without becoming identity proof. Broad laptops, phones, cameras, and displays request missing decision constraints before merchant search. Backend recommendation logic selects one stable primarySelectionId only when product fit and merchant evidence support a purchase recommendation; otherwise cards remain research-only. Official-site display order never forces the primary choice, and equally suitable trusted products prefer the lower comparable price. English and Chinese requests use the same structured decision with localized wording. Checkout remains the authority for eligibility, stacking, shipping, tax, and final totals. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Unsupported sites may use user-authorized Chrome only as a bounded fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, merchant authorization, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Initial only after Skill: EN "Searching for suitable products."; ZH "正在搜索合适商品。". No selected search line.
